outputs.total_qX: no_hole + X*hole (hole terms are for unit hole charge)

closed_form.response: Im F = L (E1) with hard gap; Re F by E4a, partial fractions of the retained band
closed_form.equations: Simonsen et al. (1997) Eqs. (13)-(17), theta = 0, coefficients from F
closed_form.quadrature: adaptive composite 24-point Gauss-Legendre in ln k_parallel; run B halves every panel of run A
closed_form.u: 2*|run A - run B| + accepted residual of run A + binary64 rounding of the stored value
closed_form.zero: below the gap term_13a and total_q1 are identically zero (value 0, u 0); numerical residuals are recorded

i3.coefficients: from h = -F of the KK code of this file (40 digits), no reciprocal of 1/eps
i3.k_parallel: composite 16-point Gauss-Legendre in ln k_parallel, panel width <= 0.35, geometric panels around the bulk lines W_i(q) = T
refinements: k_parallel panel width <= 0.175 and half the innermost panel at the bulk lines
k_perp: core panels halved, orders core 20->28, Laguerre tails 80->120, 1/k tail 32->48

samples.note: sampled with the multiprecision KK of this file; both maxima must be negative
